name: @arutech/transcription-agent
description: LiveKit Agents worker that joins a meeting room on explicit dispatch (see apps/api/src/captions) and forwards streaming speech-to-text as LiveKit's native room transcription — consumed client-side via @livekit/components-react's useTranscriptions(), not a custom WebSocket event. See docs/roadmap.md's Live captions stage for the full architecture and honest scope.
